channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Talen Horton-Tucker | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Talen Horton-Tucker from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Frank Vogel on Talen Horton-Tucker
item.description:
Ryan Ward:Frank Vogel on Talen Horton-Tucker:

“We believe he's going to be an above average three-point shooter.... But there's still a grooming element to this season.”

Frank Vogel on Talen Horton-Tucker, Dec 6, 2021. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: LeBron James on Talen Horton-Tucker
item.description:
“We talked about this the whole year. Let’s be honest, if you go back in the draft and redo the draft from last year, Talen Horton-Tucker would not go in the second round,”

LeBron James on Talen Horton-Tucker, Mar 17, 2021. Source: TalkBasket.

item.title: Frank Vogel on Talen Horton-Tucker
item.description:
Mike Trudell:Frank Vogel on @Talen Horton-Tucker, who’s had to play more w/both KCP and Caruso out:

“We just love what that young man brings to the tablein terms of his two-way productivity.”

Frank Vogel on Talen Horton-Tucker, Jan 3, 2021. Source: Twitter @LakersReporter.

item.title: LeBron James on Talen Horton-Tucker
item.description:
LeBron on Talen Horton-Tucker:

“He's experiencing some great moments for himself as a pro. ...He's going to continue to learn, he's going to continue to get the opportunities because he's earned it...”

LeBron James on Talen Horton-Tucker, Jan 2, 2021. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Kyle Kuzma on Talen Horton-Tucker
item.description:
Mike Trudell:Kyle Kuzma on @Talen Horton-Tucker:

“He’s gonna be a great player. He’s young, but he has a (high) poise and maturity to his game ... I expect big things in his future.”

Kyle Kuzma on Talen Horton-Tucker, Dec 12, 2020. Source: Twitter @LakersReporter.

item.title: Frank Vogel on Talen Horton-Tucker
item.description:
Mike Trudell:Frank Vogel on @Talen Horton-Tucker, and his willingness to put a rookie into a big playoff spot:

“He’s a good basketball player … I had confidence putting him in there. He can shoot, he can drive and he can guard, and he doesn’t try to force.”

Frank Vogel on Talen Horton-Tucker, Sep 11, 2020. Source: Twitter @LakersReporter.
